description: Apache Struts S2-062: incomplete fix for CVE-2020-17530 (S2-061) allows double OGNL evaluation via forced %{...} syntax in tag attributes — unauthenticated RCE via HTTP multipart Content-Type header (Struts 2.0.0–2.5.29).
impact: Unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted multipart POST request with OGNL expression in Content-Type header.
preconditions: Apache Struts 2 application accepting multipart form requests
Developer used forced OGNL evaluation (%{...}) on tag attributes with untrusted input
